description: The one brand vocabulary, shared by the card reader (collectai_recognizer/evidence.py) and the logo reader (logos.py). It is a seed, not a limit: every brand name in the catalog index is added to it at scan time, so a brand entered on the Add-a-car form is recognised from the next index export onwards with nothing edited here. This file is for the brands the catalog has not got yet — a box on the table whose maker nobody has entered. Add one when you meet one.
notes: `name` is what gets reported, and should be spelled the way the catalog spells it, because that is what the Add-a-car form prefills and what the matcher compares against a casting's brands.

`spellings` are what the text might read as, lower case; punctuation and spaces are ignored on both sides, so 'Mini GT' and 'minigt' are the same spelling. Add a misreading only if it is one a real logo produces — a loose spelling costs precision across every photo.

A spelling of fewer than 5 characters (BBR, TLV, M2) is only ever matched as a whole word, never inside a longer one, for the same reason short casting names are: 'bbr' falls inside plenty of words that are not a brand.

Lines are not brands. Tomica Limited Vintage and TLV Neo are Tomica's lines and the catalog files their cars under the brand Tomica, so they report Tomica; the line belongs in the series field. Same for Kaido House under Mini GT.
